content:
[Intro]
[G]
I saw the light

[Verse 1]
[G]fade from the sky
On the wind
I heard a sigh
As the snow-
[Em]flakes cover [C]My
[Em]fallen brothers [C]I will
[G]say this last [C]goodbye
[G]

[Pre-Chorus]
[Em]Night is now
[C]falling
[G]So ends this
[D]day
[Em]The road is now
[C]calling And
[G]I must away
[D]Over

[Chorus]
[Em]hill and under tree
[C]Through lands where
[Am]never light has
[C]shone By silver
[G]streams that run down
[C]to the
[D]sea
Under
[Em]cloud, beneath the
[C]stars Over
[Am]snow on winter's
[C]morn I turn at
[G]last to paths
[C]that lead
[D]home
[Am]And though where the road
[C]then takes me
[Em]I cannot tell
[D]
[Am]We came all this way
[C]But now comes the day
[Em]To bid you fare-
[D]well
Many

[Verse 2]
[G]places [C]I have
[G]been Many
[G]sorrows [C]I have
[G]seen But I
[Em]don't regret [C]Nor will
[Em]I forget [C]All who
[G]took that road [C]with
[G]me

[Pre-Chorus]
[Em]Night is now
[C]falling
[G]So ends
[D]this day
[Em]The road is now
[C]calling And
[G]I must away
[D]Over

[Chorus]
[Em]hill and under
[C]tree Through lands where
[Am]never light has
[C]shone By silver
[G]streams that run down
[C]to the
[D]sea
To these
[Em]memories I will
[C]hold With your
[Am]blessing I will
[C]go To turn at
[G]last to paths
[C]that lead
[D]home
[Am]And though where the road
[C]then takes me
[Em]I cannot
[D]tell
[Am]We came all this way
[C]But now comes the day
[Em]To bid you fare-
[D]well

[Outro]
[C]
[Em]
[C]
[Em]
[C]
[Em]I bid you
[C]all a very
[Em]fond farewell
[G]
title: The Last Goodbye
tuning: E A D G B E
